title: Record Nantucket Estate Sale: 57 Hulbert Avenue fetches $42.5m; $850,000 goes to Land Bank
summary_full: A historic waterfront estate in Nantucket Harbour was sold for $42.5 million, breaking the previous record. The property, known as Blue Waters, was owned by the Fife family for over 50 years. The sale took place on November 5, 2026, and generated $850,000 for local land conservation. The estate features direct beach access and a unique architectural design.
